name: World Rules
description: Rules for each world: mobs breaking blocks, blasts destroying items, keeping your inventory on death, sleeping in beds, the weather, natural monsters, monster light, apples from oak leaves, the falling hit bonus, bows that wear out, picking up items from a little further. They run where the world runs, so a server can use them with any client. Worlds you already have keep their rules, but for Pickup Reach, which comes on in them too.
authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic's AI), at Studio Quire
